Learn: What is EV?
The number that matters more than win rate.

Every price has a break-even point.
At odds 2.00 you must win 50% of the time just to break even.
At 1.80 you need 55.6%. At 1.50 you need 66.7%.

EV = chance × odds − 1.
55% chance at odds 2.00: 0.55 × 2.00 − 1 = +10% EV.
The same 55% at odds 1.80: 0.55 × 1.80 − 1 = −1% EV.
Same pick, different price. One has value, one does not.

Likely to win is not the same as worth the price. Every card shows both: Chance and EV.
